title: Bug or something broken
subject: Re: {original_subject}
body:
Hi{from_name_greeting},

Thanks for letting us know something is not working as expected.

To help us track it down, it would help to know your iOS version, which screen you were on, and what you did just before it happened. A screenshot is useful if you have one.

We will look into it and get back to you once we know more. No need to resend unless you notice new details.

Kind regards,
Ben support
